about_zh: 浏览器里跑的一切，从前端框架到后端服务。

repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: Public APIs是一个由社区维护的免费API目录，汇集金融、天气、地理定位、电信等多领域公共接口。该项目通过人工审核机制确保API质量，为开发者提供免费、可直接集成的RESTful服务资源。作为开发者的API宝库，它简化了寻找可靠第三方服务的流程，支持快速原型开发和产品功能扩展，是集成外部服务的理想起点。
repos.summary_en: The Public APIs repository is a community-curated directory offering free RESTful APIs across diverse domains including finance, weather, geolocation, and telecommunications. Manually reviewed for quality, this collection serves as a valuable resource for developers seeking reliable third-party services without cost. It streamlines API discovery for rapid prototyping and product development, featuring categories like stock market data, IP geolocation, weather information, and phone validation. The project is maintained by both community contributors and APILayer, ensuring ongoing updates and a well-organized structure.

repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个社区驱动的开发者学习路线图项目，提供前端、后端、DevOps、AI工程师、数据科学等30+技术方向的交互式可视化学习路径。用户可点击节点查看详细内容，涵盖从入门到进阶的完整技能体系，帮助开发者清晰规划职业发展和技术成长方向。
repos.summary_en: This community-driven project offers interactive visual learning roadmaps for developers across 30+ technical domains including frontend, backend, DevOps, AI engineering, and data science. Users can click nodes to access detailed content, covering complete skill paths from beginner to advanced levels, helping developers clearly plan career development and technical growth.

repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max Skill 是一款AI驱动的设计智能工具，通过100条推理规则和67种UI样式库，实现专业级设计系统的自动生成。支持多平台框架，提供Python CLI命令行接口，可快速分析项目需求并输出定制化UI/UX方案，涵盖从布局模式到视觉风格的完整设计体系，显著提升设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max Skill is an AI-powered design intelligence tool that automatically generates professional design systems using 100 reasoning rules and 67 UI style libraries. Featuring a Python-based CLI, it analyzes project requirements and outputs customized UI/UX solutions—from hero-centric conversion patterns to soft UI evolution styles—enabling rapid creation of cohesive, production-ready design systems across web and mobile platforms while dramatically improving design efficiency, ensuring brand consistency, and reducing development iteration cycles.

repos.description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
repos.summary_zh: Taste-Skill 是一个开源反“slop”前端框架，专为AI智能体设计。通过可移植的SKILL.md技能文件，指导Cursor、Claude Code、Codex等代理生成优质界面，强化布局、排版、动效与间距，避免通用模板。该仓库提供多种风格技能（极简、粗犷等）、redesign审计、图像到代码流程，以及网页/移动端/品牌套件图像生成技能。支持npx skills add安装、可调设计参数（方差、动效、密度），兼容多框架与AI工具，助力打造高端非模板化前端。
repos.summary_en: Taste-Skill is an open-source anti-slop frontend framework for AI agents. It provides portable SKILL.md files that guide coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to generate premium interfaces with refined layout, typography, motion, and spacing instead of generic boilerplate. The repo includes style-specific skills, redesign audits, image-to-code pipelines, and image-generation skills for web/mobile/brand reference boards. Installable via npx skills add with adjustable dials (variance, motion, density), it works across frameworks and AI tools to deliver high-quality, non-templated frontends.

repos.description: 24 Lessons, 12 Weeks, Get Started as a Web Developer
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的系统性Web开发入门课程，12周24节课涵盖HTML/CSS/JavaScript核心基础。采用项目驱动教学法，通过生态箱、浏览器扩展等实践项目强化学习效果。支持40+种语言自动化翻译，开源社区协作模式。适合零基础学习者、教育工作者及自学者快速掌握现代Web开发技能。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official 12-week web development curriculum designed for absolute beginners, featuring 24 comprehensive lessons covering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Employs project-based learning methodology through practical projects including terrariums, browser extensions, and space games. Features automated multi-language translation support for 40+ languages via GitHub Actions. Open-source and community-driven with quizzes, discussions, and assignments. Perfect for aspiring developers, educators, and self-learners seeking structured, hands-on web development training.

repos.description: The web framework for content-driven websites.
repos.summary_zh: Astro 是内容驱动网站的 Web 框架，强调服务端渲染与轻量输出。通过岛屿架构实现交互优化，支持 React 等框架集成和 Markdown 内容集合。默认零 JavaScript，具备快速构建、视图过渡和多平台部署功能。适用于博客、文档站点等内容应用，提供卓越性能与灵活扩展性。
repos.summary_en: Astro is a web framework optimized for content-driven websites, delivering powerful developer experience alongside lightweight output. It uses server-first rendering and the islands architecture for selective interactivity and minimal JavaScript. Astro supports integrations with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks, along with Markdown content collections. Features include zero JS by default, view transitions, optimized images, and deployment adapters. It excels in building blogs, documentation sites, and marketing pages with fast builds and excellent performance.

repos.description: Penpot: The open-source design platform for Product teams that need scalable collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: Penpot 是开源的设计协作工具，支持设计师创建交互式原型与设计系统，开发者可直接获取生产就绪代码。基于 SVG/CSS 等开放标准实现设计与代码无缝衔接，2.0 版本新增 CSS Grid 布局、设计令牌和组件系统，显著提升产研协作效率。支持浏览器访问或自托管，适用于产品设计全流程。
repos.summary_en: Penpot is an open-source design collaboration tool enabling designers to create interactive prototypes and design systems while providing developers with production-ready code. Built on open standards like SVG and CSS, it bridges design and development seamlessly. The 2.0 release introduces CSS Grid layout, native design tokens, and a new components system, significantly enhancing cross-functional team collaboration. Available as a web app or self-hosted solution for end-to-end product design workflows.

repos.description: Fast, accurate & comprehensive text measurement & layout
repos.summary_zh: Pretext 是一个纯 TypeScript 文本测量与布局引擎，通过绕过 DOM 测量彻底避免浏览器重排。它预计算文本分段和宽度，后续布局纯算术运算，支持多语言、RTL 和 emoji。适用于虚拟化列表、自定义布局、防止布局偏移及 AI 开发时的文本溢出验证，可渲染至 DOM/Canvas/SVG/SSR 多种环境。
repos.summary_en: Pretext is a pure TypeScript text measurement and layout engine that eliminates expensive browser reflow by bypassing DOM measurements entirely. It precomputes text segmentation and character widths, then performs subsequent layout through pure arithmetic operations, supporting multilingual text, RTL languages, and emojis. Perfect for virtualization, custom masonry layouts, preventing layout shift, and AI-assisted development text overflow checks. Renders seamlessly to DOM, Canvas, SVG, and server-side environments.

repos.description: 100+ open-source clones of popular sites like Airbnb, Amazon, Instagram, Netflix, Tiktok, Spotify, Whatsapp, Youtube etc. See source code, demo links, tech stack, github stars.
repos.summary_zh: Clone Wars是一个GitHub开源仓库，收录100多个流行网站和应用的开源克隆与替代项目，包括Airbnb、Instagram、Netflix、Spotify等。提供源码、演示链接、技术栈及星标数据，专为学习设计。分带教程的克隆表和普通克隆/替代表，展示React、Next.js、Firebase、Django等多种技术栈。核心价值是curated学习资源，帮助开发者通过实际项目掌握全栈开发、构建作品集并探索开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Clone Wars is a curated GitHub repository featuring 100+ open-source clones and alternatives to popular sites like Airbnb, Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify. It includes source code links, demos, tech stacks, and star counts for learning web development. Divided into a tutorials table for guided full-stack projects and a clones/alternatives table distinguishing UI clones from functional alternatives. Showcasing technologies such as React, Next.js, Firebase, and more, it enables developers to explore implementations of popular features, enhance skills through practical examples, and find open-source substitutes. Perfect for self-learners and portfolio building.

repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.summary_zh: Astryx 是 Meta 开源的设计系统，基于 React 19 与 StyleX，提供 150+ 无障碍组件、主题定制、暗黑模式及 CLI 工具。其开放内部结构支持任意层级组合与源码抽取，样式无锁定，可无缝对接 Tailwind 等方案，并专为人类开发者与 AI 智能体协同构建而优化。
repos.summary_en: Astryx is an open-source design system from Meta, built on React 19 and StyleX, offering 150+ accessible components, theming, dark mode, and a CLI. Its open internals allow composition at any level and source ejection, with no styling lock-in, enabling seamless integration with Tailwind and other CSS approaches, designed for both human developers and AI agents.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
repos.summary_zh: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
repos.summary_en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

repos.description: 🔥 Clone and recreate any website as a modern React app in seconds
repos.summary_zh: Open Lovable 是 Firecrawl 团队开源的 AI 驱动 React 应用生成器。通过对话式交互，用户可快速克隆并重构任意网站为现代化 React 应用。核心集成 Firecrawl 网页抓取、多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq）及 Vercel/E2B 沙盒环境，实现从 URL 到可运行代码的秒级生成，支持快速迭代与实时预览，适用于原型设计与网站迁移。
repos.summary_en: Open Lovable is an open-source AI-powered React app generator by the Firecrawl team. It enables instant cloning and modernization of any website into React applications through conversational AI interaction. The project integrates Firecrawl for web scraping, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq), and sandbox environments (Vercel/E2B) to transform URLs into runnable code within seconds, supporting rapid prototyping and website migration with real-time preview capabilities.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供1,324个健身动作的综合数据集，每个动作包含动画GIF、180×180缩略图、身体部位/器械/目标肌肉/肌群元数据，以及9种语言的分步指导说明。作为LogPress AI健身追踪应用的底层数据，支持健身应用开发、运动识别推荐的机器学习项目、健康研究及教育原型。亮点包括结构化JSON文件与验证模式、纯客户端交互浏览器（搜索筛选多语言详情）、开发者工具（多数据库SQL生成、API示例及LLM后端提示），媒体按Gym visual许可使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a ready-to-use dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with animated GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, metadata on body parts, equipment, targets and muscle groups, plus step-by-step instructions in 9 languages. It powers the LogPress AI-assisted workout tracker and supports fitness app development, ML exercise recognition/recommendation, health research, and education. Highlights include validated JSON with schema, client-side interactive browser with search/filters/multilingual details, and developer tools offering DB SQL generators, API examples across languages, and LLM prompts for backend generation. Media licensed from Gym visual.

repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

repos.description: FastAPI Best Practices and Conventions we used at our startup
repos.summary_zh: 初创公司生产环境沉淀的 FastAPI 开发规范，提供领域驱动的项目结构、Pydantic 深度使用策略、异步依赖注入优化方案，以及数据库约定、测试策略等实战指南。专为中大型单体应用设计，帮助团队建立一致、可扩展的 API 开发体系，规避架构陷阱。
repos.summary_en: Production-tested FastAPI development conventions from a startup, offering domain-driven project structure, in-depth Pydantic usage strategies, async dependency injection optimization, and practical guidelines for database conventions and testing. Designed for medium-to-large monolithic applications, it helps teams build consistent, scalable API systems while avoiding architectural pitfalls.

repos.description: Admin Dashboard UI built with Shadcn and Vite.
repos.summary_zh: satnaing/shadcn-admin 是基于 Shadcn UI 和 Vite 构建的企业级管理后台 UI 组件库。提供 10+ 预置页面、响应式布局、亮暗主题切换及完善的 RTL 语言支持，深度优化可访问性。通过自定义 Shadcn 组件与 TanStack Router 集成，为开发者提供可直接复用的生产级界面解决方案，显著加速后台系统开发。
repos.summary_en: satnaing/shadcn-admin is a production-grade admin dashboard UI library built with Shadcn UI and Vite. It features 10+ pre-built pages, responsive layouts, light/dark themes, comprehensive RTL support, and deep accessibility optimization. By customizing Shadcn components and integrating TanStack Router, it delivers reusable, enterprise-ready UI solutions that dramatically accelerate backend development.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

repos.description: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup.
repos.summary_zh: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，提供零配置、一键集成的地图解决方案。基于 MapLibre GL 构建，深度集成 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 样式体系，支持主题感知、可组合组件、标记弹窗、路线绘制等核心功能，适用于快速开发美观的地图可视化应用。
repos.summary_en: mapcn is a free, open-source React map component library that provides zero-config, one-command setup for beautiful map visualizations. Built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly integrates with shadcn/ui design patterns. Key features include theme-aware light/dark mode adaptation, composable map components, rich markers with popups and tooltips, route/path drawing capabilities, and built-in controls—enabling rapid development of sophisticated map-based applications.

repos.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
repos.summary_zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

repos.description: Skills for Design Engineers
repos.summary_zh: UI Skills 是一个面向设计工程师和 AI 智能体的专业技能集合，收录 132 多个高质量技能，聚焦无障碍审计、动效性能优化、UI 基础清理及生产级前端设计等领域。核心价值在于 npx CLI 路由工具，能智能匹配任务至最合适技能，帮助人类与代理创建优质界面。应用场景覆盖 AI 生成代码优化、WCAG 合规检查、动画流畅性提升及组件开发。技术亮点是模块化专家技能、避免通用 AI 美学及多框架实践集成，实现专业、一致的高品质用户体验。
repos.summary_en: UI Skills is a curated collection of over 132 specialized skills for design engineers and AI agents to create superior interfaces. It covers accessibility audits, motion performance fixes, baseline UI polish, and production-grade frontend design. The core value is its CLI routing tool that intelligently matches tasks to the right skill set. Applications include refining AI-generated UIs, ensuring WCAG compliance, optimizing animations, and building polished components with frameworks like React and shadcn/ui. Key highlights are modular expert-contributed guidelines that avoid generic AI aesthetics and promote high craft quality and consistency.

repos.description: High-performance browser automation bridge and multi-instance orchestrator with advanced stealth injection and real-time dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: PinchTab 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高性能浏览器自动化桥接器。通过 12MB 的 Go 二进制文件提供 HTTP API，支持多实例 Chrome 进程 orchestration 与隐身注入。核心突破在于 token 效率——文本提取仅需 800 tokens/页，成本比截图方案低 5-13 倍。具备持久化配置文件、ARM64 优化和实时仪表板，是 AI 驱动 Web 自动化的轻量级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: PinchTab is a high-performance browser automation bridge designed for AI agents. This 12MB Go binary delivers HTTP API for multi-instance Chrome orchestration with advanced stealth injection. Its breakthrough is token efficiency—text extraction costs only 800 tokens/page, 5-13x cheaper than screenshots. Featuring persistent profiles, ARM64 optimization, and real-time dashboard, it's the lightweight infrastructure for AI-driven web automation.

repos.description: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.
repos.summary_zh: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: Animated components for design engineers. 150+ free shadcn/ui components, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 为设计工程师打造的UI组件库，提供92+可复制的AI智能体模式与4个全栈模板。基于Tailwind CSS开发，完全兼容Shadcn，支持一键复制、Next.js导出或v0导入，快速构建可访问的定制化界面。
repos.summary_en: UI component library for Design Engineers featuring 92+ copy-paste AI Agent patterns and 4 full-stack templates. Built with Tailwind CSS, fully Shadcn-compatible. Integrate via copy-paste, Next.js export, or v0 import for accessible, customizable interfaces.

repos.description: Open-source ThreeUI Community catalog with live interactive components and complete Community source.
repos.summary_zh: ThreeUI Community 是开源的 Three.js/WebGL 3D 组件与交互 Shader 目录，含 50 个父组件、164 个可浏览结果。提供实时预览、变体控制、源码查看与 React 封装包，支持 npm 安装。适用于落地页 Hero、3D 背景与视觉特效开发，MIT 许可，免登录获取完整社区实现。
repos.summary_en: ThreeUI Community is an open-source catalog of procedural Three.js/WebGL 3D components and interactive shaders, featuring 50 parent components and 164 browse results. It offers live previews, variant controls, source access, and a React package via npm. Ideal for hero sections, 3D backgrounds, and visual effects. MIT-licensed, no login required.

repos.description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
repos.summary_zh: 赫蹏是专为中文网页内容设计的排版增强库，基于现代CSS与JavaScript实现。它提供网格对齐、中西文混排自动美化、标点挤压、竖排古文诗词版式等特性，支持简繁体与黑暗模式。通过简单的类名引入即可显著提升中文阅读体验，兼容主流样式重置方案，适配移动端。
repos.summary_en: Heti is a specialized typography enhancement library designed for Chinese web content presentation, implemented with modern CSS and JavaScript. It delivers grid-aligned layout, automatic Chinese-Western text spacing, punctuation compression, pre-configured layouts for classical texts and poetry, vertical writing support, and seamless dark mode adaptation. The library supports both simplified and traditional Chinese while being fully responsive for mobile devices. With simple class name integration, it dramatically elevates Chinese reading experience and is compatible with popular CSS reset solutions.

repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
repos.summary_en: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

repos.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

repos.description: 🤹 Access thousands of icons as components on-demand universally.
repos.summary_zh: unplugin-icons 是基于 Iconify 的通用图标组件库，提供超20万图标并支持150+图标集。通过按需加载机制仅打包实际使用的图标，显著减小构建体积。支持 Vite、Webpack 等主流构建工具及 React、Vue 3 等框架，具备自动导入、SSR/SSG 友好、自定义图标等特性，适用于现代前端项目。
repos.summary_en: unplugin-icons is a universal icon library leveraging Iconify, providing 200,000+ icons across 150+ sets. It enables on-demand loading to bundle only used icons, reducing bundle size. Compatible with major build tools (Vite, Webpack, Rollup) and frameworks (React, Vue 3, Svelte), it features auto-importing, custom icons, and SSR/SSG support without FOUC for modern web development.

repos.description: Terraink: The Cartographic Poster Engine that creates unique and customizable map posters
repos.summary_zh: TerraInk 是一款基于 OpenStreetMap 数据的地图海报生成引擎。用户可通过地理编码搜索全球任意地点，自定义配色主题、地图图层和字体样式，并导出高分辨率 PNG 打印文件。采用 Bun+React+TypeScript 全栈技术，集成 MapLibre 实现矢量地图渲染，为设计师和地理爱好者提供便捷的创意地图制作工具。
repos.summary_en: TerraInk is a cartographic poster engine that generates unique, customizable map posters using real OpenStreetMap data. The platform offers smart geocoding for global locations, a rich theme system with dozens of curated color palettes, detailed map layer controls for roads, water, parks and buildings, and flexible typography options with Google Fonts integration. Built on a modern Bun+React+TypeScript stack with MapLibre for vector tile rendering, it enables users to export print-ready high-resolution PNG posters at any dimension, serving as an accessible creative tool for designers, geography enthusiasts, and anyone seeking personalized map art.

repos.description: 📜 A minimalist personal website embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow.
repos.summary_zh: Shiro 是为 Mix Space 生态系统打造的极简主义个人网站主题，融合纸的纯净与雪的清新。基于 Next.js 16 App Router 构建，集成 Jotai 状态管理、Socket.IO 实时推送和 Motion 物理动画，Lighthouse 性能评分超 90。支持 Markdown 扩展、多语言、实时活动状态展示，提供优雅的写作与阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: Shiro is a minimalist personal website theme designed for the Mix Space ecosystem, embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow. Built on Next.js 16 App Router with Jotai state management, Socket.IO real-time communication, and Motion physics-based animations, it achieves Lighthouse scores above 90. The theme features Markdown extensions, multilingual support via next-intl, real-time activity status, and a dedicated 'Recently' thoughts system, delivering an elegant writing and reading experience.

repos.description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
repos.summary_zh: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
repos.summary_en: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

repos.description: Deploy Your Frontend in a Single Command. Claude Code Skills supported.
repos.summary_zh: PinMe 是一款零配置的前端静态部署工具，通过单命令将构建产物上传至去中心化网络。无需服务器管理，自动处理可用性与持久性，提供可验证内容防止篡改。深度集成 AI 工作流，支持 Claude Code 等直接部署，兼容 React/Vue/Next.js 等主流框架，为开发者与 AI 代理提供极简发布体验。
repos.summary_en: PinMe is a zero-config static frontend deployment tool that publishes sites to decentralized networks with a single command. It eliminates server management, automatically handling availability and persistence while providing verifiable content to prevent tampering. With deep AI workflow integration supporting Claude Code, it offers a frictionless publishing experience for developers and AI agents, compatible with React/Vue/Next.js frameworks.

repos.description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
repos.summary_zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
repos.summary_en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

repos.description: Handwriting animation for the web. Supports any font or text.
repos.summary_zh: Tegaki 是一个网页手写动画库，能将任意字体转化为自然的手写动画效果。无需手动路径绘制或原生依赖，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架及多语言内置字体。适用于演示、教学、创意设计和视频制作场景，提供自定义字体生成和跨平台集成，技术实现纯 Web 且易于使用。
repos.summary_en: Tegaki is a powerful web library designed to transform any font into realistic animated handwriting effects. Without the need for manual path creation or native dependencies, it animates text stroke by stroke with natural timing. It provides seamless support for popular frameworks including React, Svelte, Vue, and SolidJS, along with built-in fonts covering multiple languages such as Latin, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean. This makes it perfect for use in presentations, educational materials, creative web designs, and programmatic video creation. Additionally, it includes tools for generating custom font bundles and easy cross-platform integrations.

repos.description: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16
repos.summary_zh: 基于Next.js 16、TypeScript与Shadcn UI的现代化管理后台模板，提供CRM、财务等多场景仪表板。支持亮暗主题切换、响应式布局与同构文件系统架构，内置Tailwind CSS v4、Zustand状态管理和TanStack Table数据处理，助力快速构建可扩展的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Modern admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Shadcn UI, featuring multiple pre-built dashboards for CRM, finance and other business scenarios. Supports light/dark theme switching with multiple color presets, responsive layouts, and colocation-based file system architecture for better code organization. Integrated with Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand for lightweight state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. Includes authentication flows and role-based access control (planned). Enables rapid development of scalable enterprise applications with customizable themes and flexible layouts.

repos.description: Give your AI agent access to your live Chrome session — works out of the box, connects to tabs you already have open
repos.summary_zh: 让AI智能体直接操控正在使用的Chrome浏览器，无需重新登录或启动新实例。通过Chrome原生调试协议建立持久连接，支持截图、DOM操作、网络监控等能力。相比Puppeteer方案，可访问已登录状态，稳定处理百个标签页，适合需要与真实浏览器环境交互的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Enables AI agents to directly control your live Chrome session without relogin or new instances. Establishes persistent connections via Chrome's native debugging protocol, supporting screenshots, DOM manipulation, and network monitoring. Unlike Puppeteer-based solutions, it accesses authenticated states and reliably handles 100+ tabs, ideal for agents interacting with real browser environments.

repos.description: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
repos.summary_zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
repos.summary_en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

repos.description: Components from design to production
repos.summary_zh: LiftKit是一个面向设计师的UI框架，通过数学公式自动实现设计最佳实践。核心提供缩放、间距和色彩的系统化解决方案，确保视觉对称、比例平衡和色彩平滑过渡。目前仅支持Next.js，正处于重写阶段以符合现代开发标准。项目由兼职维护者开发，暂不建议生产环境使用。其平台无关的设计系统可无缝集成到现代前端工作流中。
repos.summary_en: LiftKit is a UI framework for perfectionists that automatically enforces design best practices through mathematical formulas for scaling, spacing, and color. It ensures optical symmetry, balanced proportions, and smooth color ramps without manual effort. Currently Next.js-only, it's being rewritten with Base UI primitives to meet modern standards. The designer-built system is platform-agnostic and aims to make developers better designers. Maintained by part-time contributors, it's not production-ready yet but offers a robust foundation for design-system-driven development with community-driven expansion and Tailwind integration efforts.

repos.description: Free, open-source web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, design your own visually, export as RDF/XML, and share interactive diagrams. Zero backend, fully static.
repos.summary_zh: Ontology Playground是一款免费开源的纯静态网页应用，专为学习本体论及Microsoft Fabric IQ语义建模设计。用户可浏览零售、医疗等六大领域预构建本体目录，使用可视化编辑器设计本体并实时预览Cytoscape.js交互图表，支持RDF/XML导入导出与GitHub一键PR提交。内置结构化学习课程、实验室、任务系统及嵌入式组件，采用React 19和TypeScript构建，无后端依赖。适用于数据工程师与AI开发者快速掌握企业知识图谱构建技能。
repos.summary_en: Ontology Playground is a free, open-source, fully static web app for learning ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ semantic modeling. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies across six domains like Retail and Healthcare, visually design with live Cytoscape.js graph previews, import/export RDF/XML, and submit PRs via GitHub. Features a learning hub with courses, labs, quests, and embeddable widgets. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, zero backend. Ideal for data professionals and AI developers mastering enterprise knowledge graphs.

repos.description: A high-performance ASCII video rendering engine featuring real-time WebSocket binary streaming and an isolated compiler for serverless static generation. Built for low-latency 30 FPS playback on HTML5 Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: ASCILINE是一款高性能跨平台实时ASCII视频渲染引擎，通过WebSocket二进制帧流传输至HTML5 Canvas，实现超低延迟30FPS播放。核心价值在于将视频像素映射为纯文本画布，支持实时CSS滤镜、低带宽零GPU运行及轻量LLM的AI语义处理。采用Python/FastAPI后端结合OpenCV和NumPy解码映射，支持多色彩模式、自适应编解码、音频同步、播放列表及YouTube/摄像头流。适用于低资源设备、交互式网页媒体交付和嵌入式场景，无需传统视频标签。
repos.summary_en: ASCILINE is a high-performance, cross-platform real-time ASCII video rendering engine that streams binary-encoded frames via WebSockets to HTML5 Canvas for ultra-low latency 30 FPS playback. It transforms video into pure typographic canvas content, enabling real-time CSS filters, low-bandwidth zero-GPU operation on constrained devices, and seamless integration with lightweight LLMs for AI processing. Python/FastAPI backend uses OpenCV and NumPy for decoding and mapping; vanilla JS frontend handles rendering. Supports multiple color modes, adaptive codecs, audio sync, playlists, YouTube, and webcam streaming. Ideal for interactive web media, embedded systems, and low-resource environments without video elements.

repos.description: A Calibre plugin to translate ebook into a specified language.
repos.summary_zh: Bookfere Ebook Translator 是为 Calibre 设计的专业翻译插件，集成 Google、DeepL、ChatGPT 等主流引擎及自定义 API 支持。插件全面兼容 Calibre 48 种输入格式，提供高级与批量双模式，支持多任务并行翻译与智能缓存，可无缝集成至 Calibre 库管理，是跨语言阅读与电子书本地化的技术解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Bookfere Ebook Translator is a professional Calibre plugin integrating Google Translate, DeepL, ChatGPT, Gemini, and custom APIs to translate ebooks across 48 input formats. It offers advanced and batch modes, parallel processing, intelligent caching, and seamless Calibre library integration, delivering a robust solution for cross-language reading and ebook localization with extensive customization options and format compatibility.

repos.description: Blender's GPU Accelerated UI, Decoupled from it's original codebase. Supports Rust, Python, JS, Lua, C & C++. Twice as good as GPUI
repos.summary_zh: BUI 将 Blender 历经数十年优化的 GPU 加速 GUI 解耦为独立库，支持 Python、Rust、JavaScript (React/Svelte)、C、C++ 及 Dear ImGui 等多种语言和框架。具备高能效、低内存占用与极速渲染特性，跨 Windows/Linux/macOS 平台，适合构建高性能桌面应用界面。
repos.summary_en: BUI decouples Blender's decades-optimized GPU-accelerated GUI into a standalone library, supporting Python, Rust, JavaScript (React/Svelte), C, C++, and Dear ImGui. It delivers high energy efficiency, low memory footprint, and blazing-fast rendering across Windows, Linux, and macOS, ideal for building high-performance desktop UIs.

repos.summary_zh: reg-factory 是一套全自动注册流水线：批量自注册 Outlook 邮箱，再用同一邮箱在 ChatGPT/Grok/Claude 上注册账号并导出直登 Cookie。核心采用比特浏览器实现指纹隔离、Clash Verge 代理节点切换绕过区域与 Cloudflare 限制，结合接码打码服务完成验证。基于 Python + Playwright 构建，适用于 AI 服务批量测试与账号管理场景。
repos.summary_en: reg-factory is a fully automated registration pipeline: batch self-register Outlook emails, then use them to create accounts on ChatGPT/Grok/Claude and export direct-login cookies. It uses BitBrowser for fingerprint isolation, Clash Verge for proxy switching to bypass geo-blocks and Cloudflare, plus SMS/captcha services. Built on Python + Playwright, ideal for bulk AI service testing and account management.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram Channel into a MicroBlog.
repos.summary_zh: BroadcastChannel 是一个基于 Astro 的工具，可将 Telegram 频道转化为轻量级微型博客。它无需浏览器端 JavaScript，提供 SEO 友好的站点地图和 RSS 订阅，支持 Cloudflare、Vercel 等无服务器部署。用户只需配置频道用户名，即可快速搭建独立博客，实现内容同步与自定义域名绑定。
repos.summary_en: BroadcastChannel transforms your Telegram channel into a lightweight microblog using Astro. It requires zero client-side JavaScript, delivers SEO-friendly sitemaps and RSS feeds, and supports deployment on serverless platforms like Cloudflare and Vercel. Simply configure your channel username to launch a standalone blog with custom domain support.

repos.description: Perplexity style AI Search engine clone built with Gemini 2.0 Flash and Grounding
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Gemini 2.0 Flash 的 AI 搜索引擎，提供 Perplexity 式实时问答体验。核心亮点在于 Google Search Grounding 技术，确保答案附带可溯源的引用来源。全栈 TypeScript 架构（React + Express）实现高效开发，支持会话内追问，适用于研究、学习与精准信息检索场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini-Search is a production-ready AI search engine clone that replicates Perplexity's core functionality using Google's cutting-edge Gemini 2.0 Flash model. Its key technical innovation lies in the Search Grounding integration, which fetches real-time web results and automatically generates citations for every answer. The full-stack TypeScript implementation combines React with Vite on the frontend and Express.js on the backend, delivering a responsive, modern interface with conversational memory. Designed for researchers, students, and professionals seeking accurate, traceable information with minimal latency.

repos.description: ChirmyRam OneDrive Repository
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于国际版OneDrive构建的超大规模媒体资源仓库，总存储量达150TB，涵盖动画、影视、剧集、电子书等分类。项目采用多账号负载均衡架构，通过alist目录程序提供WebDAV和Rclone访问支持，解决了API调用限制问题。内容按中文拼音和英文首字母双重索引组织，主要提供MKV格式内封字幕视频。技术亮点包括Golang单文件部署、多盘符抽象管理、以及完整的播放器推荐方案。
repos.summary_en: A massive OneDrive-based media repository totaling 150TB+ across nine dedicated drives for animations, movies, TV series, 4K ISOs, and e-books. The project implements multi-account load balancing via alist (Golang) to overcome API throttling, offering WebDAV and Rclone access protocols. Content is dual-indexed by Chinese pinyin and English names, primarily in MKV format with embedded subtitles. Key technical features include single-binary deployment, abstracted multi-drive management, and comprehensive media player recommendations for optimal playback experience.

repos.description: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
repos.summary_zh: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 网页端封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的代理工具。它利用浏览器自动化技术实现多账号管理、工具调用及生图/TTS 模型访问，提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录功能，便于开发者将 AI Studio 能力无缝集成到现有应用。
repos.summary_en: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that converts Google AI Studio's web interface into OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic-compatible API formats. Leveraging browser automation, it supports multi-account management, function calling, and access to Gemini models for image generation and text-to-speech. The tool provides a web console with VNC login capabilities, enabling seamless integration of AI Studio features into existing applications.

repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

repos.description: Free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher for web scraping and multi-accounting. By the ShardX team (formerly ProxyShard). Engine-level fingerprint spoofing in Chromium 158 (WebGL / WebGPU / Client Hints / fonts / TLS), 220+ device profiles bundled, stable QUIC + WebRTC over SOCKS5.
repos.summary_zh: ShardX 是开源反检测浏览器启动器，基于修改版 Chromium 152 引擎实现多层指纹伪装，内置 220+ 设备配置，支持 SOCKS5 代理下 QUIC/WebRTC，提供多语言 SDK 与 MCP 服务，适用于网页爬虫与多账号管理。
repos.summary_en: ShardX is a free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher built on a patched Chromium 152 engine with deep fingerprint spoofing across WebGL, WebGPU, Client Hints, fonts, and TLS layers. It bundles 220+ device profiles, supports stable QUIC and WebRTC over SOCKS5 proxies, and provides multi-language SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Rust along with a local API and MCP server. Designed by the ProxyShard team, it is ideal for web scraping and multi-account management workflows at scale.

repos.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
repos.summary_zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
repos.summary_en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

repos.description: Outlook 注册机
repos.summary_zh: OutlookRegister 是一款自动化 Outlook/Hotmail 账号注册工具，基于 Patchright/Playwright 模拟人类填表行为，支持自动过验证码、代理池与并发，集成 moemail 临时邮箱或 Outlook Graph API 辅助验证，可将成功账号存储至 Results 目录，适用于批量账号获取场景。
repos.summary_en: OutlookRegister is an automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration tool using Patchright/Playwright to simulate human form-filling, with auto captcha solving, proxy pools, concurrency, and support for moemail temp emails or Outlook Graph API verification. Successful accounts are saved to Results, ideal for bulk account generation.

repos.description: This is a project that unifies the management of LLM APIs. It can call multiple backend services through a unified API interface, convert them to the OpenAI format uniformly, and support load balancing. Currently supported backend services include: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepBricks, OpenRouter, Gemini, Vertex, etc.
repos.summary_zh: uni-api 统一管理 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等主流 LLM API，转换为标准 OpenAI 格式。支持权重/地域/轮询四种负载均衡、自动重试与渠道冷却机制，纯配置文件管理，无前端依赖，适合个人部署。
repos.summary_en: uni-api unifies LLM APIs into OpenAI format. Supports 4 load balancing types, auto-retry, channel cooling, pure config management, no frontend, ideal for personal deployment.

repos.description: 微信读书 koreader 插件，在 koreader 里阅读微信读书里的书籍、公众号文章，支持阅读进度同步，阅读时长上报和统计，本地书籍支持获取微信读书划线和想法内容，支持Kindle、Kobo等所有能安装 koreader 的设备。
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书 KOReader 插件，可在 Kindle、Kobo 等设备上阅读微信读书书籍与公众号文章，支持进度同步、时长统计、划线想法获取及章节预下载，打通封闭系统与微信读书生态。
repos.summary_en: KOReader plugin for WeRead on Kindle/Kobo: progress sync, reading stats, highlights, pre-download.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

repos.description: A Cursor skill that gives AI agents real UI component knowledge — best practices, layout patterns, and design-system conventions for 60+ interface components — so it generates production-grade UI instead of generic output.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 Cursor AI 技能，为 AI 编程注入 60+ UI 组件的专业设计知识，包括最佳实践、布局模式和设计系统规范。通过消除 AI 的随意猜测，它能自动生成符合现代 SaaS、企业级或创意风格的生产级前端代码，显著提升 UI 开发质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: This Cursor AI skill provides AI agents with deep expertise on 60+ UI components, covering accessibility standards, responsive layout patterns, and design system conventions meticulously curated from component.gallery. It eliminates generic output by delivering specific best practices, common layouts, and anti-patterns for each component, automatically generating production-grade interfaces in five style presets: Modern SaaS, Apple-level Minimal, Enterprise/Corporate, Creative/Portfolio, and Data Dashboard. The result is senior-designer-quality UI code that follows proven patterns without manual template assembly, significantly accelerating frontend development workflows.

repos.description: DeepSeek 逆向 API
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

repos.summary_zh: Shadcn Builder 是为 shadcn/ui 量身打造的可视化表单构建器，通过拖拽式操作和实时预览，让开发者无需编写代码即可创建美观、可访问的表单。工具直接生成生产就绪的 React + Tailwind CSS 代码，完美契合 shadcn/ui 组件体系，实现零配置快速上手，大幅提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Shadcn Builder is a powerful no-code form builder specifically designed for the shadcn/ui component library. It enables developers to visually create beautiful, accessible forms through drag-and-drop interface with live preview, then exports clean, production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code. With zero configuration required and seamless shadcn/ui integration, it dramatically accelerates frontend development while maintaining code quality and type safety.

repos.description: Curated Motion Core Svelte components
repos.summary_zh: 面向Svelte 5的精选生产级动效组件库，采用shadcn式copy-paste架构，通过CLI直接注入源码。封装GSAP与OGL，实现流畅WebGL与时间轴动画，覆盖磁力按钮、3D无限画廊等，专为实验性高性能网页设计打造。
repos.summary_en: Curated production-ready motion components for Svelte 5, using a shadcn-inspired copy-paste architecture via CLI. Wraps GSAP and OGL for smooth WebGL and timeline animations, including magnetic buttons and 3D galleries, focused on high-end experimental web motion design.

repos.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。
repos.summary_zh: TavilyProxyManager 是一个专为 Tavily API 设计的高可用代理网关，核心解决多 API Key 的额度聚合与智能调度问题。通过 Master Key 统一鉴权，实现基于剩余额度的动态负载均衡与自动故障切换，有效规避频率限制。内置 Vue3 管理面板提供 Key 管理、用量监控与请求日志分析，同时集成 MCP 协议端点，无缝对接 Claude 等 AI 工具。Go 语言构建，单二进制部署，Docker 开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: TavilyProxyManager is a high-availability proxy gateway designed for Tavily API, solving multi-key quota aggregation and intelligent scheduling. It unifies authentication via Master Key, implements dynamic load balancing based on remaining credits with automatic failover to avoid rate limits. The built-in Vue3 dashboard provides key management, usage monitoring, and request log analysis, while integrated MCP protocol endpoints seamlessly connect with AI tools like Claude. Built with Go, it offers single-binary deployment and Docker-ready out-of-the-box.

repos.description: A tiny TypeScript web agent, hill climbed on real browser evals.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Pi Mono与CDP的TypeScript浏览器智能体，通过持久化V8 REPL执行JavaScript控制Chrome，支持会话保持、登录态复用、流式输出与无障碍树交互，适用于网页自动化与数据采集。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight TypeScript web agent built on Pi Mono LLM and raw Chrome DevTools Protocol, using a persistent V8 REPL to execute JavaScript and control Chrome browsers. The agent dynamically writes its own helper functions, supporting session persistence, saved logins, streaming output, typed results, and accessibility-tree interaction. Designed for browser automation, web scraping, and data collection tasks, with cloud browser support requiring no local Chrome installation. Features include ultrafast mode for interaction-heavy tasks, interaction highlights, screen recordings, and GIF exports for visual debugging.

repos.summary_zh: JioFarm是一款Python自动化工具，通过租用印度Jio虚拟号码登录Jio自助服务，自动猎取Google AI Pro/Gemini Pro兑换链接。采用多SMS服务商模块化架构，配备Rich实时仪表盘，发现链接后自动推送Telegram通知。
repos.summary_en: JioFarm is a Python automation tool that rents virtual Jio numbers to hunt Google AI Pro/Gemini Pro redeem links via Jio selfcare. Features modular multi-provider architecture, Rich live dashboard, and Telegram notifications.

repos.description: Open-source SRS
repos.summary_zh: Memcode 是一款专为开发者与学习者设计的现代化间隔重复闪卡应用。核心亮点在于深度融合编程学习场景，支持代码块、LaTeX公式与多媒体内容，并集成 OpenAI 高质量文本转语音。其 LLM 友好的纯文本导入导出格式，便于 AI 辅助知识管理，实现美观、高效、无摩擦的学习体验。
repos.summary_en: Memcode is a modern spaced repetition flashcard app designed for developers and learners. It excels in programming education with support for code blocks, LaTeX formulas, and multimedia. Integrated OpenAI text-to-speech delivers high-quality audio, while LLM-friendly plain text import/export enables seamless AI-powered knowledge management, combining beauty with effortless learning.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
repos.summary_zh: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.

repos.description: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
repos.summary_en: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

repos.description: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
repos.summary_zh: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
repos.summary_en: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

repos.description: spoo.me is an open-source & API first link management infra
repos.summary_zh: spoo.me 是一个开源、API 优先的短链接管理服务，提供自定义 slug（含 emoji）、密码保护、点击限制等高级功能。其核心亮点在于强大的分析能力，支持地理位置、设备、流量模式、引荐来源和机器人检测的多维度统计，并提供 CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML 数据导出。无需注册即可使用，支持自托管，完全免费且无功能限制，适合需要私有化部署或集成短链能力的开发者和企业。
repos.summary_en: spoo.me is an open-source, API-first URL shortening infrastructure offering advanced features like custom slugs (including emojis), password protection, and click limits. Its core strength lies in comprehensive analytics covering geographic distribution, device breakdown, traffic patterns, referrer tracking, and bot detection, with multi-format data export (CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML). Requiring no registration, it provides completely free unlimited usage with self-hosting capability. Ideal for developers and enterprises needing private deployment or integrated link management with detailed click insights.

repos.description: Google AI Studio and Gemini Web provider for Magpie (Gemini 4 Carbon / Hydrogen / Argon, Nano Banana image generation, Deep Research), backed by AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 插件，通过本地后端将 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini 网页版转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账号额度调度、工具调用与实验性 Argon 模型，无需额外依赖。
repos.summary_en: A Magpie plugin that converts Google AI Studio and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible APIs through local backends. It automatically downloads and manages AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go, enabling users to access Google's large language models directly from Magpie without additional dependencies. Features include multi-account quota scheduling with per-account cards, native function calling for AI Studio, simulated tool calling for Gemini Web, cookie-based authentication, proxy support, and experimental Argon model access. Both providers can be configured simultaneously for flexible and diverse usage scenarios.

repos.description: Read premium articles for free with this Bookmarklet
repos.summary_zh: Readium 是一个轻量级书签工具，通过 JavaScript 技术绕过付费墙限制，让用户免费访问 Medium、Substack 等平台的优质内容。项目采用 Vue.js 构建官方网站，部署于 GitHub Pages，提供一键式便捷操作。相比浏览器扩展，书签形式无需安装，更加便携高效，是数字内容自由访问的实用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Readium is a lightweight bookmarklet that bypasses paywalls to provide free access to premium content on platforms like Medium and Substack. Built with Vue.js and deployed on GitHub Pages, it offers a one-click solution without requiring browser extension installation. This portable tool leverages JavaScript to remove content restrictions, delivering a streamlined alternative to traditional ad-blockers or subscription management tools for effortless reading of gated articles. Its open-source nature ensures transparency and community-driven improvements.

repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT订阅支付链路自动化研究项目，聚焦支付流程（直卡/PayPal BA/hCaptcha）的工程实现与代理对齐。基于FastAPI后端核心引擎与React前端面板，支持多代理池与接码对接，仅供学习研究使用。
repos.summary_en: Research project on automating ChatGPT subscription payment chains, covering card binding, PayPal BA flows and hCaptcha handling. Built with FastAPI backend engines and React frontend panel, integrating multi-proxy pools and SMS services for study purposes only.

repos.description: 一个用于AI驱动开发的通用任务管理系统，使用Google Gemini模型，专为与Cursor AI无缝协作而设计。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个专为AI驱动开发设计的智能任务管理系统，深度适配Cursor等AI编程工具。系统采用免费的Gemini 2.5 Pro模型替代Claude，显著降低成本并提升稳定性。核心亮点包括：融合业务知识库实现精准任务拆解、智能自动确定任务粒度、提供可视化Web界面管理、支持中英双语输出，有效解决中文开发者在AI编程中的任务管理痛点。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent task management system designed for AI-driven development, deeply integrated with AI coding tools like Cursor. It replaces costly Claude with free Gemini 2.5 Pro for stability and cost-efficiency. Key features include: business knowledge base integration for precise task decomposition, automatic granularity determination, visual web UI management, and bilingual (EN/ZH) support, streamlining AI development workflows for Chinese developers.

repos.description: 地址生成器:Random US tax-free state address generator with real OSM/USPS data — map-verified on Google Maps, supports global countries (HK, India, RU, etc.), multi-language (ZH/EN/RU/ES/PT), pure frontend, no server storage.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个纯前端的地址生成器，基于真实OSM/USPS数据生成美国免税州及多国地址，支持多语言且无需后端存储。核心亮点在于生成的地址可通过Google Maps验证，提供灵活的配置接口与模块化设计，适用于测试数据生成和隐私敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: A pure frontend address generator using real OSM/USPS data to create US tax-free state and global addresses. Features Google Maps-verifiable outputs, multilingual support, and zero server storage. Designed for test data generation with configurable data paths and modular architecture.

repos.description: Video to ASCII React component.
repos.summary_zh: react-video-ascii 是一个基于 WebGL2 的高性能 React 组件，可将视频实时转换为 ASCII 艺术。支持自定义字符集、亮度/饱和度调节及字形/亮度双渲染模式。内置鼠标悬停高亮/散射、点击波纹/扩散动画及加载揭示效果。适用于创意编码、艺术展示和网页特效场景，通过 GPU 加速确保流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: react-video-ascii is a high-performance React component that converts videos to ASCII art in real-time using WebGL2 acceleration. It offers extensive customization including character sets, brightness/saturation controls, and dual rendering modes (shape/luminance). Features interactive mouse hover effects (brighten/scatter), click animations (ripple/spread), and reveal transitions. Ideal for creative coding, artistic displays, and web experiments with smooth GPU-accelerated rendering.

repos.description: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok2API，适配最新的Web调用格式，支持流式对话、图像生成、图像编辑、联网搜索、视频生成、深度思考，支持号池并发调用和自动负载均衡。
repos.summary_zh: Tomiya233/grok2api 将 xAI 的 Grok 大模型封装为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，基于 FastAPI 构建。核心亮点包括：异步流式处理架构确保高并发性能，智能号池管理与负载均衡机制最大化调用稳定性，自动缓存解决资源链接 403 限制，提供完整的管理界面与统计监控。适用于需要将 Grok 集成至现有 AI 应用或构建高可用 Grok 服务的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Tomiya233/grok2api wraps xAI's Grok model into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces using FastAPI. Key features include: asynchronous streaming architecture for high concurrency, intelligent token pool management with auto load balancing, automatic caching to bypass 403 restrictions, and comprehensive admin dashboard with statistics. Enables developers to integrate Grok into existing AI applications or build highly available Grok services with enterprise-grade reliability.

repos.summary_zh: Sprite Lab是一款纯浏览器端工具，专为图像背景去除与精灵图自动切割设计。无需上传或AI模型，利用Canvas API实现多通道alpha抠图消除边缘光晕，并通过连通像素扫描智能检测帧。支持动画预览、帧排除及ZIP导出（含manifest），全部本地处理，保障隐私与离线可用。适用于2D游戏开发和动画资产准备。
repos.summary_en: Sprite Lab is a fully client-side web tool for automatic background removal and spritesheet slicing. Using only the HTML Canvas API, it detects backdrops like green screens or checkerboards and applies multi-pass alpha matting to eliminate edge halos. Connected pixel analysis enables intelligent frame detection without grids. Features include animation previews, frame exclusion, and ZIP exports with manifests. Everything runs locally with no uploads, AI, or servers—ideal for 2D game asset preparation.

repos.description: minimalism, blog theme for Astro
repos.summary_zh: Astro Air 是一款基于 Astro 框架的极简多语言博客主题，支持中、英、日、韩等五种语言，内置置顶文章、阅读时长、目录导航、暗色主题及 RSS 订阅等丰富功能。采用 Bun 作为包管理器和运行时，提供流畅的动画交互与响应式布局，适合追求简洁与性能的个人博客站点。
repos.summary_en: Astro Air is a minimal multilingual blog theme built on Astro, supporting five languages including English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. It features pinned posts, reading time, table of contents, dark mode, and RSS feeds. Powered by Bun for fast tooling, it delivers smooth animations and responsive layouts, ideal for personal blogs prioritizing simplicity and performance.

repos.description: hotmail register
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于Python的Outlook/Hotmail自动化注册工具，采用ruyiPage库驱动Firefox浏览器实现全流程自动化。支持批量注册、代理IP、验证码服务集成及无头模式，可生成虚假注册信息并保存账号凭证。适用于测试研究等非商业场景，采用PolyForm非商用许可证。
repos.summary_en: This Python automation tool leverages ruyiPage library to control Firefox browser for fully automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration. Key features include bulk account creation with configurable delays, proxy server support for IP rotation, integration with 2captcha for automated captcha solving, headless mode operation, and fake identity generation using Faker library. Designed specifically for testing and research purposes under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license, it automatically saves credentials to text files with comprehensive logging and screenshot capture capabilities.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供半自动 NVIDIA BUILD 账号注册工具，使用 Playwright 浏览器自动化完成邮箱创建、注册表单、验证码填写及 NGC API Key 生成，仅手动处理 hCaptcha。集成自建临时邮箱服务，实现端到端流程自动化。核心价值在于简化开发者获取 NVIDIA AI Playground 密钥的流程，节省重复操作时间。技术亮点包括 Playwright 端到端控制、邮件轮询验证与 API 调用集成。仅限学习交流用途。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a semi-automated tool for registering NVIDIA BUILD accounts and generating AI Playground API keys. It uses Playwright for browser automation to handle email creation via a self-hosted temp mail service, form submissions, verification code polling, and NGC API key creation, requiring only manual hCaptcha solving. Core value lies in streamlining access to NVIDIA AI tools for developers. Technical highlights include end-to-end browser control, email integration, and automated API interactions. Intended solely for educational purposes.

repos.description: AI MVP应用的通用template
repos.summary_zh: fast-mvp是专为AI应用打造的全栈开发模板，基于Next.js App Router实现前后端一体化。集成tRPC与Zod提供全链路类型安全，配合Drizzle ORM管理SQLite数据库。通过TokenRoll插件深度对接Claude Code，为AI初创项目提供开箱即用的MVP验证方案，显著缩短从概念到产品的开发周期。
repos.summary_en: fast-mvp is a full-stack template designed for AI applications, unifying frontend and backend via Next.js App Router. It ensures end-to-end type safety with tRPC and Zod, while Drizzle ORM manages SQLite databases. Deeply integrated with Claude Code through TokenRoll plugin, it provides an out-of-the-box MVP validation solution for AI startups, dramatically accelerating development cycles.

repos.description: Static File Browser by Astro
repos.summary_zh: 基于Astro的静态文件浏览器，专为Cloudflare Pages设计。构建时扫描public目录生成预渲染HTML，提供现代化目录列表界面，支持MDX内容注入、SEO优化及自定义错误页。解决静态托管平台缺乏autoindex功能的问题，适合需要美观、可浏览文件索引的场景。
repos.summary_en: A static file browser built with Astro for Cloudflare Pages. Pre-renders directory listings at build time with modern UI, MDX support, SEO optimization, and custom error pages. Solves the lack of autoindex on static hosting platforms, ideal for creating browsable file indexes with zero server-side logic.

repos.summary_zh: 这个Python工具用于自动化破解阿里云滑动验证码。核心价值：通过OpenCV图像识别精准定位缺口位置，结合Selenium浏览器自动化模拟人类滑动轨迹，有效绕过阿里云验证码防护。应用场景：网络爬虫数据采集、自动化测试。技术亮点：集成ddddocr识别、undetected-chromedriver防检测、人类行为模拟算法，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: This Python tool automates bypassing Alibaba Cloud slider captchas. Its core value lies in using OpenCV for precise gap detection and Selenium for human-like drag simulation to effectively circumvent Aliyun captcha protection. It is ideal for web scraping data collection and automated testing scenarios. Key technical highlights include integration with ddddocr for recognition, undetected-chromedriver for anti-detection, sophisticated human behavior simulation algorithms, and full cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

repos.description: Turn a private Hugging Face repo into your own cloud storage service.
repos.summary_zh: Hugging Cloud 将私有 Hugging Face 仓库转化为自托管云存储服务，专为 AI 团队管理模型与数据集设计。基于 FastAPI+Next.js 全栈架构，提供 RBAC 权限控制、可恢复上传和签名链接安全访问。Docker 容器化部署，支持 SQLite/Postgres 和 Redis，兼顾轻量便捷与生产级扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Hugging Cloud transforms private Hugging Face repositories into self-hosted cloud storage services, purpose-built for AI teams managing models and datasets. Built on a modern FastAPI+Next.js stack, it delivers enterprise-grade features including RBAC access control, resumable uploads, and cryptographically signed download links. Docker containerized deployment supports both SQLite for lightweight use and Postgres/Redis for production scalability, enabling seamless integration into existing AI infrastructure while maintaining data privacy and access governance.
